title: Bee Removal Edison, NJ
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Edison, NJ. Wall-void nests, soffit nests, and structural treatments. NJDEP-licensed.
intro: Edison, New Jersey residents facing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, or ground bee problems need swift, professional intervention to protect their families and properties. An active nest inside a wall void, soffit, attic, or eave is a structural problem that won't resolve itself. Our expert technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible nest material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization throughout Edison.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience serving the Edison community with humane, environmentally responsible bee removal techniques. Our team — licensed or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — respond quickly, uses specialized equipment to safely relocate or remove bee colonies, and provide follow-up inspections to ensure your property remains bee-free.
localContext: Edison's mix of suburban homes, the Menlo Park Mall area, and historic neighborhoods like Clara Barton present unique challenges for stinging-insect control — from wasp and hornet nests in the attics and soffits of ranch-style homes to yellow jacket colonies in wall voids of commercial properties along Route 1. Our team understands the specific architecture and landscape features of Edison properties, ensuring effective nest treatment and removal whether you're near Roosevelt Park or in the Oak Tree Road business district. Ground-nesting yellow jackets are common in Edison's lawns and landscaped areas, and carpenter bees frequently target the wooden trim and eaves of older structures.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Edison, NJ?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Edison property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for most Edison locations. Emergency nest removal is available for situations involving aggressive defenders or nests near entryways. Our typical nest treatment and removal process takes 1–3 hours depending on colony size and nest location.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Edison?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
